title.narrative: Area-Based Development Solutions to Internal Displacement

description.narrative: This Joint Programme by UNDP, UNHCR, IOM, and FAO (the PUNOs) will support the Government of Yemen’s national authorities (the Executive Unit for IDPs) and local authorities to design and implement gender and conflict-sensitive area- based, development-oriented durable solutions to displacement by inducing systemic change through 1. Developing joint assessments of the situations, needs, and solutions preferred by IDPs and host communities, while building the capacity of local Government to shape evidence-based innovative investment and to measure progress; 2. Supporting national and local authorities efforts to facilitate the integration of IDPs through integrated policy innovation, legal reform, and institutional change; and 3. Testing innovative measures to amplify locally tailored, community-led, needs-based development solutions in pilot locations in Aden, Marib, Taiz, and Lahj, drawing lessons for eventual scaling up.The activities are closely interconnected: The joint integrated assessments will serve as baselines to understand the intentions and needs of IDPs, particularly conflict-affected women and children, host communities, and local authorities, as well as the underlying socio-economic and security-related causes of displacements and the potential for successful integration. The process of developing them will provide hands-on capacity-building to national and local authorities on data collection, analysis, and use towards developing locally tailored, gender and conflict-sensitive, needs-based, durable, and development- oriented solutions initiatives with the affected communities. Robust capacity-building activities will support the Executive Unit for IDP Camp Management (ExU) at the national level and local authorities at the governorate level in programming for durable solutions. The joint work will feed into the development of an action plan at the national level for the 2013 National Policy for Addressing Internal Displacement in the Republic of Ye

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
